UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA ALEXANDRIA DIVISION

MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE,

Plaintiff,  v.  KATIE HALL, individually; NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED CHILDREN; META PLATFORMS, INC.; and JOHN/JANE DOES 1–6,

Defendants. ____________________________________/

Case No. 1:26-cv-02331

DECLARATION OF MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE IN SUPPORT OF PLAINTIFF’S RENEWED RULE 56 MOTION FOR PARTIAL SUMMARY JUDGMENT

I, Marvelle J. Ballentine, declare as follows pursuant to 28 U.S.C. § 1746:

1.	I am the Plaintiff in this action. I make this Declaration based upon my personal knowledge. I am competent to testify to the matters stated herein.

2.	Exhibit 3 is a true and correct copy of the Opposition of Defendants Katie Hall and the National Center for Missing & Exploited Children to Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to File a First Amended Complaint, filed at ECF No. 20 in Ballentine v. National Center for Missing & Exploited Children, No. 1:26-cv-01341-MSN-WBP (E.D. Va.) (the “1341 Action”), which I obtained from the Court’s electronic docket for that action. It is docketed in this action at ECF No. 7-4.

3.	Exhibit 4 consists of true and correct copies of the two letters dated April 22, 2026, signed by Katie Hall on the letterhead of the National Center for Missing & Exploited Children, which I received by mail at my address of record and which are the letters described in the Complaint. The copies in Exhibit 4 are reproduced from ECF No. 5, Exhibits A and B, in the 1341 Action. They are docketed in this action at ECF No. 7-5.

4.	Exhibit 5 consists of true and correct copies of the written materials I transmitted on April 9, 2026 to the Legal Department of the National Center for Missing & Exploited Children, providing advance notice of subpoenas I intended to serve. The copies in Exhibit 5 are reproduced from ECF No. 5, Exhibit C, in the 1341 Action. They are docketed in this action at ECF No. 7-6.

5.	On April 9, 2026, I transmitted written materials to the Legal Department of the National Center for Missing & Exploited Children, providing advance notice of subpoenas I intended to serve.

6.	Before April 22, 2026, I never used the name “Marvelle J. Ballentine” to create, register, identify, maintain, access, or operate any account on any product or service owned or operated by Meta Platforms, Inc. that I used.

7.	I never used “Marvelle J. Ballentine” as a username, profile name, display name, account name, or other identity by which I identified myself on Facebook, Instagram, Threads, WhatsApp, Oculus, Meta Quest, or any other Meta product or service that I used.

8.	I did not provide “Marvelle J. Ballentine” to Meta Platforms, Inc. as the name identifying me or any Meta account that I created, maintained, or operated.

9.	On July 4, 2022, Meta Platforms, Inc. invoked its Child Sexual Exploitation policy against the Facebook account that I operated.

10.	The Facebook account against which Meta invoked that policy was operated by me under the name “Jay Ballentine.”

11.	Meta’s July 4, 2022 enforcement action was not issued against an account operated by me under the name “Marvelle J. Ballentine.”

12.	In connection with my online identity, including my use of Meta products and services, I used the name “Jay Ballentine,” rather than “Marvelle J. Ballentine.”

13.	To the extent “Marvelle J. Ballentine” appeared in the April 9, 2026 correspondence, draft subpoena materials, or other litigation materials that I transmitted to the National Center for Missing & Exploited Children, I included that name because it is my legal name and the name under which the underlying federal litigation was pending.

14.	I did not include that name because I had used it to identify or operate any Meta account.

15.	The foregoing statements concern my own use of my name, my own operation of Meta products and services, and my own preparation and transmission of the litigation materials referenced above. Each of those matters is within my personal knowledge.

I declare under penalty of perjury under the laws of the United States of America that the foregoing is true and correct.

Executed on November 1, 2026.

Marvelle J. Ballentine
